inputClasses: Recipe for the installed export stub pack

invariants: apply materialises the dependency graph (21 nodes, 2 materials, 4 expressions in the factory avatar), reports invalidations and bumps the revision
dryRun mutates nothing and consumes no requestId; a replay is idempotent

stale expectedRevision is a conflict; wrong template sha256 is validationFailed; unknown template is missingCapability; a schema-only recipe is invalidRequest; the revision is unchanged after every rejection
the rights resolver runs on every apply: a conflicting declaration is gateFailed at /rights/meta/authors with revision 0; a renaming resolver's name reaches the built VRM meta
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass
scope.units: metres (body.heightM), normalized control values, quaternion transforms
excluded: garment fit and hair regeneration (control-set and build packs)
